item.title: Alipato at Muog, Screened in La Union
item.author: zirdl.giography@gmail.com (gio)
item.description: Alipato at Muog, Directed by JL Burgos, brother to Jonas Burgos, an enforced disappearance victim, and whom the documentary is about, was screened in various schools and a Library in La Union. Alipato at Muog was awarded the Special Jury Award during the Cinemalaya Film Festival of 2024 and was rated X by the MTRCB, which then was lifted as there's no substantial basis for the rating.
